investigations.name: chemotactic-recruitment
investigations.title: Chemotactic recruitment
investigations.question:
Does a secreted chemotactic cue drive directional migration and recruitment of
responder cells into the source region, and does inhibiting the chemotactic
response reduce that recruitment?
investigations.hypothesis:
In a Cellular Potts world where source cells secrete a diffusible field and
responder cells chemotax up its gradient, responders will directionally migrate
toward and accumulate near the source region. Removing either the cue or the
response abolishes recruitment.

investigations.name: glazier-graner-1993
investigations.title: Glazier & Graner 1993 — differential-adhesion cell rearrangement
investigations.question: Can a single extended-Potts (Cellular Potts) model with only differential surface energies and an area constraint reproduce the full range of differential-adhesion-driven cell-rearrangement phenomena reported by Glazier & Graner (Phys. Rev. E 47, 2128, 1993)?
investigations.hypothesis: Varying only the type-dependent adhesion energies J(tau,tau') and the area constraint reproduces checkerboard mixing, complete and partial cell sorting, engulfment, position reversal, dispersal, and cavity formation, with matching patterns and topological statistics.

investigations.name: influenza-sego2022
investigations.title: Influenza infection & immune response (Sego 2022 reproduction)
investigations.question:
Can viva-cpm's native Cellular Potts engine reproduce, to quantitative figure
match, the cellularized multiscale influenza-infection and immune-response
model of Sego et al. 2022 — built on CompuCell3D's ViralInfectionVTM — at
paper scale (Figs 3B, 5, 7)?
investigations.hypothesis:
A CPM composite that reproduces the paper's cell types (epithelial,
macrophage, NK, CD8+ T), diffusible fields (virus, type-I IFN, chemokine,
IL-10), per-cell resistance/state transitions, and coupling to the global
immune ODE compartment — parameterized from the CC3D source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as ground truth, cross-checked against the paper's own
tables — will land within the paper's reported acceptance bands for
infected/uninfected/dead epithelial counts and immune-cell trajectories
across the initial-viral-load and initial-infection-fraction scenario
sweeps.
